[[Highlands]] |Sell Price = {{Price|10000}} |dsvprice = 10000 }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an item that can be obtained by eliminating [[Bully Rex]]. Eight {{PAGENAME}}s can be found on the floor of the [[Treasure Cave]], which respawn up to 7 additional times after, for a total of 64 possible Ornate Treasure Chests. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a '''universally liked''' gift, with the following exceptions. {{Gifting |love= Lance |dislike= Linus }} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes. ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in tailoring or dyeing. ==Trivia== *Unlike with a [[Stardew:Treasure Chest|Treasure Chest]], if an {{PAGENAME}} is gifted to [[Linus]], he will accept the gift.
